page.title: Community Goals
page.intro: Everyone on the forum works toward these together. Every reply, discussion and like counts.
page.none: No goals right now. Check back soon!
page.none_manage: No goals yet. Set the first one and get everyone working toward it.
page.no_history: Finished goals will be listed here.
page.error: These goals couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.

goal.helpers: {count, plural, =0 {Be the first to help} one {# member helping} other {# members helping}}
goal.helped: {count, plural, one {# member helped} other {# members helped}}
goal.mine_none: You haven't added to this one yet.

counts.replies: Replies in public discussions, written while the goal runs.
counts.discussions: New discussions started while the goal runs.
counts.likes: Likes given to other members' posts while the goal runs.
counts.members: Members who join (and confirm their email) while the goal runs.
counts.tag_posts: Posts in {tag}, written while the goal runs.
counts.custom: This number is kept by the forum's staff.

goal.hidden_note: Hidden, unapproved and private posts don't count, and a post that is removed is taken off again.

celebrate.reached: We did it! {title} reached its goal. Thank you, everyone!

top_modal.title: Top contributors
top_modal.empty: Nobody has added to this goal yet.

manage.delete_confirm: Delete "{title}"? Its history and contributors go with it. This can't be undone.
manage.recount_done: The count is being rebuilt. It will update in a moment.
manage.add_progress_prompt: How much to add? Use a negative number to take some away.

form.title: New goal
form.name: Goal
form.description_placeholder: Optional. Why it matters, or how members can help.
form.reward_placeholder: Unlocks the Halloween theme for a week
form.rewards_help: Handed out the moment the goal is reached.
form.rewards_none: Install Wardrobe, Festoon or FoF Badges for more automatic rewards.
form.theme: Make a Wardrobe theme the forum's default
form.badge: Give a FoF badge to everyone who helped
form.badge_min: Only members who added at least
form.announce_body_help: Leave the title and text empty for a ready-made post. In your own, these are filled in when the goal is reached:

fields.title: The goal's title
fields.reward: The reward text from this form
fields.top: The top 3 helpers with their counts (empty on new-member goals)
fields.link: The address of the Goals page

form.frozen: This goal has been reached or is over, so only its wording can change.
form.complete_confirm: {reason} Complete the goal now? Choose Cancel to change the target instead.
form.rewards_admin: Only admins can set automatic rewards.

notification.preference: Someone reaches a community goal I helped with

settings.placement: Show running goals on the discussion list
settings.placement_hero: As a banner above the list
settings.placement_sidebar: As a card in the sidebar (a banner on phones)
settings.manage_link: Goals are set and edited on the forum's Goals page.

api.tag_required: Choose the tag whose posts count.
api.target_invalid: The target must be a whole number between 1 and 10,000,000.
api.ends_invalid: The goal has to end after it starts, and in the future.
api.too_long: A goal can run for a year at most.
api.progress_locked: This goal is counted by the forum, or is already over.
api.target_reached: {count} already counted, so this goal would be reached the moment it's saved, and its rewards handed out.

announce.title: We reached our goal: {title}!
announce.reached: Together we got to {progress} of {target}, with {members} members helping.
announce.link: Thank you, everyone! See all our goals: {link}

gdpr.export: How much you added to each community goal.
gdpr.delete: Your part in running community goals is taken out, and your name is removed from every goal's contributors.
